summary: Iteration 4 (audience-capture + real waitlist + Resend) verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (waitlist create/idempotency/422/unknown-audience-coerced/count/Resend test-mode). Frontend: all CTA audience-picker flows pass, Pricing CTA -> #cta scroll + audience selection works, Professional sub-card -> sub-chip + detail-line works, success/error toasts behave per spec, no console errors. Resend test-mode confirmed: email_sent=true for torrancel42@gmail.com (curl-verified), email_sent=false (record still persisted) for any other address.

idempotency.same_email_same_audience: returns identical id + created_at on 2nd POST — verified
idempotency.same_email_different_audience: creates new record with distinct id — verified

test_results_detail.GET_/api/waitlist/count: returns {count: int}; increments after insert — verified

resend_test_mode.other_addresses: email_sent=false but record still persisted — verified across all non-owner tests

frontend_cta_audience_picker.single_select_toggling: kids -> team -> deselect team — verified via class bg-white/10

frontend_form_submission.submit_with_doctors_audience_posts_corre: POST /api/waitlist {email, audience: 'doctors', source: 'cta'} — verified via page.on('request')
frontend_form_submission.success_toast_contains_audience_label: 'Doctors mode beta' present in body after submit — verified
frontend_form_submission.submit_without_audience_shows_generic_to: 'on the list. We'll write quietly.' — verified
frontend_form_submission.invalid_email_shows_FE_validation_toast: 'Please enter a valid email.' — verified (noValidate working)
frontend_form_submission.server_422_path_note: Could not trigger from UI because pydantic EmailStr accepts 'a@b.c' which also passes FE regex. The error-toast code path exists and copy matches spec ('Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.'). 'a@b' is caught by FE regex first. Backend correctly returns 422 for 'a@b' (verified in pytest).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean implementation. Idempotency key (email lower-cased, audience) is correct and matches spec. Email send is non-blocking via asyncio.to_thread — good.

server.py L240-244: logging.basicConfig and logger init are AFTER _send_confirmation_email (which references `logger`). _send_confirmation_email() uses module-level `logger` — works at call time because functions resolve names lazily, but the order is fragile. Consider initializing the logger immediately after imports.
audienceStore.js: module-level singleton store via useSyncExternalStore is clean and idiomatic. setAudience(value) silently nulls unknown keys — matches backend coercion. Good.

CTA.jsx L20-25: useEffect that triggers smooth-scroll on every audience change will also scroll when user picks a chip directly inside the CTA (which is already in view) — harmless because the section is already top-aligned, but worth noting.

Pricing.jsx L141: pricing CTAs are <a href='#cta'> with onClick setAudience — relies on browser anchor jump rather than smooth-scroll. Works (CTA.jsx useEffect re-triggers smooth-scroll after audience change), but slightly redundant.
Backend .env: RESEND_API_KEY is committed in plaintext to /app/backend/.env — fine for preview env but should be rotated before any public deploy.
No data-testid on the close (X) icon inside a selected chip — minor; chip itself has the testid so tests can re-click to deselect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable spec items (server-422 toast path not externally inducible from UI but code/copy match spec)

test_credentials: Resend verified owner: torrancel42@gmail.com (email_sent=true only for this address; all other addresses persist with email_sent=false — documented Resend test-mode behaviour, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Pytest inserts ~9 TEST_*/COUNT_* waitlist records per run. Idempotency on (email, audience) means repeat runs don't duplicate primary records. No cleanup is performed (collection 'waitlist' on the preview Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 wires the previously-mocked waitlist into FastAPI + Mongo + Resend. POST /api/waitlist accepts {email, audience?, source?} and is idempotent on (email lower, audience). Unknown audiences coerced to null. EmailStr (pydantic) accepts 'a@b.c' — to test the FE server-error toast path, prefer mocking the network. Frontend audience store is a module-level useSyncExternalStore singleton (audienceStore.js) — calling setAudience anywhere updates CTA picker in real time. Pricing CTAs and Professional sub-cards both call setAudience and rely on CTA.jsx's useEffect for smooth-scroll. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py -v`.
